integrity: Computer-assisted finite exhaustive proof with exact integer arithmetic; no independent scientific validation or publication-priority certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to independent-edge Reed-Frost epidemics with one fully removed vertex and uniform seed on a finite tree; finite exhaustive classification only through eight vertices; neither Markov SIR with correlated outgoing transmission nor arbitrary graphs are covered.
title: Eight vertices are the sharp onset of transmissibility-dependent single-node vaccination on trees
